text: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。赵乐际委员长出席。 会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。报告介绍了2025年10月以来金融工作主要进展及成效、当前经济金融形势和问题挑战，提出下一步工作考虑：继续实施好适度宽松的货币政策，为经济持续向新向优向好发展营造适宜的货币金融环境；进一步加强和完善金融监管，不断增强监管质效；提升金融服务实体经济适配性，加快建设多层次现代金融市场体系，服务经济结构转型升级和高质量发展；稳步深化金融改革和高水平对外开放，维护国家金融安全；实施好支持资本市场
text_en: The 25th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress held its second plenary meeting on the morning of the 3rd at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Chairman Zhao Leji attended. The meeting heard a report on financial work delivered by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng on behalf of the State Council. The report covered the main progress and results of financial work since October 2025, the current economic and financial situation and challenges, and set out next steps: continue to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to create a suitable monetary and financial environment for the economy's sustained development toward innovation, improvement and positive momentum; further strengthen and improve financial regulation, continuously enhancing regulatory quality and effectiveness; enhance the adaptability of financial services to the real economy, accelerate the building of a multi-tiered modern financial market system, and serve the transformation and upgrading of the economic structure and high-quality development; steadily deepen financial reform and high-level opening up, and safeguard national financial security; implement well capital market support
